questions.q: What is the AWS Management Console?
options: A single browser-based web app that fronts all of AWS's 200+ services through one consistent layout
A separate website for each individual AWS service
A desktop-only application that cannot be accessed from a browser
A command-line tool with no visual interface
questions.explain: The console is one consistent web app in front of every AWS service, not a separate site per service.

questions.q: Why does the Region selector matter so much in the console?
options: Almost everything you see is scoped to whichever Region is currently selected — a resource created in one Region won't appear when a different Region is selected
It only changes the console's display language
It has no real effect and exists purely for cosmetic purposes
It only affects billing currency, not what resources are visible
questions.explain: Most resources exist in exactly one Region, so switching the selector changes what the console shows you.

questions.q: A teammate says their S3 bucket 'disappeared' from the console. What's the most likely explanation, per this lesson?
options: They're looking at the wrong Region in the Region selector
AWS deletes resources automatically after 24 hours
S3 buckets are only visible to the original creator's IAM user, permanently
The console has a hard limit of one bucket visible at a time
questions.explain: This is explicitly the most common cause called out in the lesson — the Region selector is pointed somewhere the resource doesn't exist.

questions.q: What's the difference between the Services search bar and the Services menu?
options: The search bar jumps straight to a named service; the Services menu groups all services by category for browsing when you don't know the exact name
They do exactly the same thing and exist purely for redundancy
The search bar only works for compute services, not storage or database services
The Services menu requires a paid support plan to access
questions.explain: Search is fastest when you know the name; the categorized menu is for browsing when you don't.

questions.q: What kind of service is exempt from being scoped to a single selected Region in the console?
options: A global service, such as IAM, whose resources appear regardless of which Region is selected
Every AWS service is exempt from Region scoping
Only services released in the last twelve months
Services accessed exclusively through the AWS CLI, never the console
questions.explain: IAM is called out as a global service — its resources show up no matter which Region is selected.
